namespace = recovery
recovery.1 = {
    type = country_event
    immediate = {
        add_modifier = recovery_modifier
        kill_character = yes
        scope:recovery_entry = { set_variable = recovery_seen }
    }
    option = { name = recovery.1.a }
}

recovery.2 = {
    type = country_event
    immediate = { add_modifier = recovery_modifier }
    option = { name = recovery.2.a }
}
